03b502d277bd1aea.zh: 在故乡萨巴拉，他本是天才。六岁学音乐，十三岁写诗。在总督府的沙龙聚会上，只要有人给出一个主题句——比如 Hei de amar-te até morrer（我将爱你至死）——曼陀林拨响的同时，七音节的即兴诗句已从他嘴里流出，作词、谱曲、演唱同时完成。十九世纪的巴西批评家后来盛赞他是“我国最优秀的即兴诗人之一”，并专门为这种才能造了一个词：repentista（即兴诗人）。
03b502d277bd1aea.en: In his hometown of Sabara, he was a genius. He studied music at the age of six and wrote poetry at the age of thirteen. Nineteenth-century Brazilian critics later praised him as "one of the finest improvisational poets in our country" and coined a term specifically for this talent: repentista (improvisational poet).

206d2ed680ddc2dd.zh: 她完成了常人难以企及的自我启蒙：精通八种语言（葡萄牙语、希腊语、拉丁语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语、德语、英语）；独自完成了《圣经·诗篇》全部一百五十篇的葡语意译；写下了一千多首诗。她翻译、模仿与意译的作品总数超过两百一十四首，涵盖至少二十七位世界顶级文学大师，从古希腊的萨福一直到与她同时代的拉马丁，横贯两千五百年的西方文学史。她甚至是葡萄牙历史上最早把德国文学系统性带入本国视野的先驱。
206d2ed680ddc2dd.en: She completed a self-enlightenment that was beyond the reach of ordinary people: she was proficient in eight languages (Portuguese, Greek, Latin, Spanish, French, Italian, German, English); she completed all 150 Portuguese translations of the Bible and Psalms alone; and she wrote more than 1,000 poems. She translated, imitated and translated more than 214 works, covering at least 27 of the world's top literary masters, from Sappho in ancient Greece to her contemporary Lamartine, spanning 2,500 years of Western literary history.
